operation_scope: The preceding read/run flags describe this metadata-only preparation call, not prior attempts

prior_actual_tag_exposure.development_status: Actual tag exposed for subsequent development; no held-out or independent accuracy claim
prior_actual_tag_exposure.diagnosis: ROOT-authorized post-fit syntax inspection; optional empty MINC labels confirmed
prior_actual_tag_exposure.initial_attempt: metadata gate passed; exact full tag read; syntax refused before accuracy computation

release_requirement: Separate ROOT-authored release binding this preparation, evaluator and complete successful fit metadata chain before any tag open

specification.coordinate_convention: MINC and NIfTI world coordinates identical; active sform RAS mm; no LPS conversion of tag points
specification.duplicate_policy: retain every row at equal weight; flag exact repeated pair/before/during indices; never deduplicate
specification.identity_baseline: before point unchanged in the shared RAS-mm frame
specification.inclusion: inverse active sform; closed native voxel-cell bounds [-0.5, shape-0.5]
specification.inclusion_policy: report before, during, identity-predicted during and rigid-predicted during inclusion; retain every finite row
specification.malformed_or_nonfinite_policy: reject the complete evaluation; do not drop individual rows
specification.point_order: first three before/reference world mm; last three during world mm; original 1-based row indices
specification.primary_endpoint: delta_RMS_mm = RMS(rigid TRE) - RMS(identity TRE); negative is lower error
specification.short_tag_policy: never read or split; overlaps the full tag
specification.tag_format: ASCII MNI Tag Point File; Volumes=2; exactly six numbers per point row, optionally followed by one empty quoted label
specification.tre: Euclidean norm(predicted during point minus observed during point), millimetres
specification.unit_of_observation: one TRAIN person; points are paired observations within that person
